title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode10 Three-Person Session?

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichiii! The weather's so perfect today, huh!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see you're in a really good mood. Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh! Not yet, but I'm going shopping after school.
Wanna come with?
Musical Instrument Shop

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, so that's what you're after.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! We've got a band now, so I want to have a keyboard I chose myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm prepared to spend all the pocket money I've been saving!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, you really are determined. But you know, expensive doesn't necessarily mean best. Why don't you ask the store staff for advice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess I could do that. Do you see any staff around?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! It's Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki? And Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, how are you? Haven't seen you since that time in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What are you up to? Shopping?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. You?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe! I'm also looking to buy something♪
A synthesizer!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because we started a band! Miku and her friend from SEKAI are helping us practice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Are you kidding me?
You're doing band practice with Miku?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can just hang out in that weird world and it doesn't bother you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's not weird, it's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, you're still playing bass, right?
Are you in a band?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see where this is going. Listen, I've got no intention of joining your band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, don't be like that!
I haven't even asked yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
.....
I'm not in a band, but I sometimes play bass at the live house where I work if the usual bassist can't make it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine on my own.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But...I want to spend more time with you! Lots more!
And I want you in our band!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want Hona to join too! Let's play together, the four of us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You haven't changed a bit since elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? How so?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Back then you used to pester me to play with you every day.
Even though I kept telling you I wanted to be left alone to play games at home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're making it sound like I was really pushy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You were, and you still are. Just like my sister. In the end, I had no choice but to give in.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry... But you know, I just really wanted to play with you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I joined a band once, in junior high. An older member from the school pop music club invited me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It turned out the other members treated it more like a social club. They couldn't even play a single song half-decently.
We got into an argument...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And in the end, they kicked me out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not going to join a band that doesn't take itself seriously.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you learn to play this song by next week?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's this? Oh, it's sheet music?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you can play this with me, I'll consider joining your band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll learn it! I'll start practicing right away! You too, right, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I've got to go to work now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Ichi, we're going to learn to play this song perfectly! We can do this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Saki, thanks. Without you, I'd have given up on Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe! I guess it takes someone as stubborn as me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can't waste this chance. We've got to start practicing and master this song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But first, I'm buying a new keyboard!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Excuse me, could you help us with something?
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They want me to play with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I thought it was best if I just kept my distance...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Was that a shooting star?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
What was that? A shooting star? Oh no, I missed it!
Where did it go?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Saki, shooting stars disappear really quickly. You have to watch the sky carefully to see one.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I'm trying but I can't see any!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: You have to be patient. Let's keep looking.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... It was just a plane.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess there's no way you could see a shooting star from here.
